questions.stem_text:
When considering economic tools for security policy, which of the following is the odd one
out?

options.A: Withdrawal of economic trade rights with the domestic market.
options.B: Export controls protecting technological advantage and further foreign policy objectives.
options.C: Control of munitions and arms sales.
options.D: Import restrictions to protect a domestic market from foreign goods.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Withdrawal of economic trade rights with the domestic market.

questions.stem_text: According to Realists, what accounts for the onset of the Cold War?

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Both b and c

questions.stem_text: What drives US foreign policy according to the Marxist perspective?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - The search for new markets

questions.stem_text: How did the Cold War context shape US perceptions of the Third World?

options.A: The US ignored the Third World
options.B: Local developments were viewed through a geopolitical lens

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Local developments were viewed through a geopolitical lens
